// @path: src/lib/ops/session.ts
// The operator's own credential columns deliberately avoid the banned names:
// Session.token is banned so OperatorSession stores tokenHash, and
// Teacher.passwordHash is banned so Operator stores pwHash. Word-boundary
// matching is what makes that work, and this fixture is the proof it still
// does now that the match is case-insensitive.
import "server-only";
import { randomBytes, createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { compare } from "bcryptjs";

export const OPS_COOKIE = "__Host-sj_ops";

export function newSessionSecret() {
  const secret = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const tokenHash = createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest("hex");
  return { secret, tokenHash };
}

export async function checkOperatorPassword(candidate, pwHash) {
  return compare(candidate, pwHash);
}
